role: Converts H10 exercise recordings into RR beat series and encodes/decodes the app's exercise-id start stamp (yyyyMMddHHmmss, POSIX, Gregorian, local zone), remembering the zone each app-written id was written in so it reads back in that zone.
types: StrapExerciseDecoder: enum — exercise id formatting/parsing, newest-recording selection, duration and RR point reconstruction (no quality filter by design)
state: private static zonesKey = "StrapExerciseDecoder.zoneById.v1" (UserDefaults key: id → time-zone identifier)

units.does: Formats `date` as a 14-digit yyyyMMddHHmmss id used as the H10 exercise id, in `timeZone` when given, else in the current zone, which is then remembered for the id (rememberZone) so the id reads back in it.
units.entry: Called from PolarManager+Recording.swift:196 when arming the H10; tests StrapExerciseDecoderTests and strap flow tests.

branches.effect: formats in TimeZone.current and remembers that zone for the id; an explicit zone is used as given and nothing is remembered

units.does: Parses a 14-digit all-numeric id back into the recording start Date: in `timeZone` when given, else in the zone the id was written in when remembered (writtenZone), else the current zone; nil for any other id. A phone that changed zone or DST offset between arming and download reads back the real start.

branches.cond: id is 14 chars and all digits
branches.effect: false: returns nil (id not written by this app); true: DateFormatter parse (nil if invalid date)
explicit zone wins; else the remembered zone of the id; else TimeZone.current (ids written before zones were remembered, or by tests with explicit zones)

units.does: Records `zone`'s identifier for `id` in the UserDefaults dictionary zoneById.v1, dropping the lexicographically smallest (oldest) ids beyond the 32 kept.

branches.effect: the oldest ids are removed until 32 remain; otherwise nothing removed

units.does: The time zone remembered for an app-written exercise id, or nil when none was remembered or the identifier no longer resolves.

Picks the entry whose id-encoded start is latest (each id read in `timeZone` when given, else its remembered zone, else the current one); with notBefore nil falls back to the first listed entry when none is dated; with notBefore returns the latest dated entry starting at or after notBefore−2 s, or nil.
units.entry: Called from PolarManager+Recording.swift:402 (notBefore nil) and StrapRecordingCoordinator+Transfer.swift:469 (notBefore = recordedSince).

branches.effect: true: newest dated entry, else (??) entries.first (an undated, foreign-id recording) when none is dated; false: filter by earliest start
no dated entries → entries.first (nil if list empty)

units.does: Builds a DateFormatter with en_US_POSIX locale, Gregorian calendar, the given time zone and format yyyyMMddHHmmss.
Sums rr_ms across points (Int64) and returns seconds.
Builds RRPoints from raw ms intervals, each stamped at the cumulative sum of the previous intervals (t_ms starts at 0); no validity filtering.
units.entry: Called from PolarManager.swift:563 (H10 fetchExercise conversion); tests.

branches.effect: appends a point and advances cumulative time; empty input → empty result
